items.title: Update to the Site Reputation Policy
items.summary: Effective Aug 30. Outside the EEA, a manual action now demotes only the affected section. In the EEA, manual-action impact no longer applies; the section may be separated to rank on its own over time.

items.event: Spam policy extended to AI answers
items.title: Spam policies now cover AI Overviews and AI Mode
items.summary: Google's spam policies explicitly apply to attempts to manipulate AI Overviews and AI Mode.

items.title: Back button hijacking added to spam policies
items.summary: Announced Apr 13; Search Console warnings and enforcement began Jun 15.

items.title: Google September 2026 Spam Update Is Rolling Out
items.summary: Google released the September 2026 spam update on Sep 24, applying globally and to all languages, and said the rollout may take up to two weeks. Search Engine Roundtable noted the three earlier 2026 spam updates each took about two days.
items.quote: Released the September 2026 spam update, which applies globally and to all languages.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15

items.title: Google Search Ranking Volatility Hits September 23rd & 24th
items.summary: Search Engine Roundtable reported significant Google Search ranking volatility starting around September 23 (possibly September 22) and continuing through September 24. The report was updated to note that Google had confirmed the September 2026 spam update began rolling out.
items.quote: UPDATE: Google has confirmed the September 2026 spam update started to roll out today.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15

items.title: Google September 2026 Spam Update Weekend Impact
items.summary: Search Engine Roundtable reported that the first stage of Google's September 2026 Spam update appeared to cause substantial ranking movement starting Friday, September 25, with more movement Saturday and easing Sunday. The article says it is still early in the two-week rollout and that the update's targets are not yet fully known.
items.quote: The first stage of the Google September 2026 Spam update seems to have been felt in a big way starting Friday, September 25th, with even more movement on Saturday, September 26th and then ending on Sunday, September 27th.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15

items.title: Phase Two Of The Google September 2026 Spam Update Hits On 9/30
items.summary: Search Engine Roundtable said September 30 may have marked a second phase of the September 2026 spam update, after movement on September 25–27. It cited Glenn Gabe, who said several site owners reported a large drop on 9/30.
items.quote: September 30th may have been the second wave, the second phase of this Google spam update.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15

items.title: Google Search Spam Updates Use AI To Find AI Spam & More
items.summary: Search Engine Roundtable relayed John Campbell’s (We Are Roast) recap of Google Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe: Google has run more spam updates because there is much more new content, is using AI to help catch spam, and warned that scaled content is becoming more of a problem than link spam. These are secondhand notes, not a Google statement.
items.quote: The team is now using AI to help catch more of it.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15

items.title: Google September 2026 Spam Update Phase Three Hit October 4
items.summary: Search Engine Roundtable reports renewed volatility around October 4–6 during the ongoing September 2026 spam update. The article's author believes this may be a final, third phase; Google has not confirmed a phase-specific start.
items.quote: I believe we are seeing the final phase of the Google September 2026 spam update rolling out between October 4th and October 6th, today.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15

items.title: Google September 2026 Spam Update Has Finished Rolling Out
items.summary: Google’s Search Status Dashboard logs the September 2026 spam update from Sep 24, 09:15 PT to Oct 8, 01:00 PT (about 13 days 16 hours). Search Engine Roundtable contrasted this with the roughly two-day rollouts of the previous 2026 spam updates and listed impact dates of Sep 25–27, Sep 30, and Oct 4–6.
items.quote: The Google September 2026 spam update is now done rolling out.
items.verified_note: Checked against the source article and Google's Search Status Dashboard on 2026-10-15
